test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is G-7?

options.text: 7 IMF-described advanced economies in the world

solution:
The correct answer is **7 IMF-described advanced economies in the world**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Group of Seven **is an **inter-governmental political forum **consisting of **Canada**, **France**, **Germany**, **Italy**, **Japan**, the **United Kingdom**, and the **United States**. In addition, the **European Union **is a **'non-enumerated member**.
 
• The **G7 provides global leadership **and **plays a powerful catalyst role **on issues that are later taken up by other **fora **with **broader global and regional membership**.
 
• The **G7 brings together **the **world's advanced economies **to **influence global trends **and **tackle pervasive **and **crosscutting issues**.
 
• The **G7 is an organized group **of **seven countries **that are **regarded **as some of the **world's largest 'advanced' economies **that are **highly positioned in global trade **and the **international financial system**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Leaders of the Group of Seven **(G7), who met in **Elmau**, **Germany**, on **26-28 June 2022**, were joined by the Leaders of **Argentina**, **India**, **Indonesia**, **Senegal**, and **South Africa**, as well as **Ukraine**.
 
• The choice of **Taormina **as the **headquarters **of the **G7 **was **announced **by the then **Prime Minister Matteo Renzi on 4 July 2016**.
